8.7.2 Optional interfaces
This chapter defines all interfaces that are required to fulfill an optional functionality of
the module.
[SWS_Fr_00391] Definition of optional interfaces in module Fr ⌈
API Function
Header File
Description

<none>
Invokes the SchM_Enter function to enter a module
local exclusive area.
SchM_Exit_Fr
<none>
Invokes the SchM_Exit function to exit an exclusive
area.
⌋()
Further optional interfaces might be accessed in case the Fr uses other modules for
accessing the CC hardware.
